app.title: Mosaicast
about.heading: About
about.whatBody: This site runs on Mosaicast — an open-source platform for podcasts. It unifies a show's feeds, gives every episode a page worth sharing, and lets the people who run it add features through plugins.
about.pluginsBody: What this instance is running, and who to credit for it.
about.builtBody: Mosaicast stands on a great deal of other people's work.
about.shipsHeading: Ships in the site you are using
about.buildHeading: Used to build and test it
tabs.label: Podcasts
filter.label: Filters
feed.emptyHint: Try a different season or tag, or clear the filters.
share.heading: Share
episode.noNotes: No show notes for this episode.
episode.pinsHint: Pinned episodes always show first, above whatever the site works out on its own.
common.comingSoon: This view arrives in the next milestone.
account.title: Account
account.playbackDevice: This switch applies to this browser. Signing in on another device sets it there separately.
account.tokensHelp: For automation (e.g. stats upload). Sent as a Bearer token.
account.tokenOnce: Copy your token now — it is shown only once:
account.lastIdentity: You can't remove your only login.
account.name.heading: Display name
account.name.label: Your name
account.name.help: This is the name other people on this site see. It was taken from the account you signed in with, and you can change it here.
account.name.failed: Your name could not be changed. Please try again.
account.name.display-name-invalid: Names must be between 3 and 32 characters.
account.name.display-name-refused: That name is not available. Please pick another.
account.name.display-name-taken: Somebody else already uses that name.
account.name.display-name-locked: You have changed your name recently. Please try again later.
account.avatar.heading: Picture
account.avatar.help: Your picture is always served by this site, so the account it comes from is never exposed to anyone viewing the page.
loginError.account_conflict: That account is already linked to another user. Log in with your existing method, then link it in your account.
loginError.link_required: An account with that email exists. Log in with your existing method, then link this one in your account.
admin.forbiddenBody: You don't have access to this area.
admin.title: Admin
admin.languages.title: Languages
admin.languages.intro: Which languages the shell offers, and which ones content may be written in. Drop a catalog file into the languages directory to add one — no rebuild needed.
admin.languages.dropInHint: Extra catalogs are read from {{dir}}. Name a file after its language code, e.g. nl.json.
admin.languages.noDropInDir: No languages directory is configured. Set MOSAICAST_LOCALES_DIR to add languages without a rebuild.
admin.navigation.title: Navigation
admin.navigation.intro: Which plugin pages appear in the site menu, and in what order. Feeds are listed automatically and are managed under Feeds.
admin.navigation.empty: No plugin declares a page, so the menu shows only feeds.
admin.navigation.reorderHint: Drag a row to reorder, or use the arrows. The order here is the order in the site menu.
admin.navigation.labelsNote: Entry names come from each plugin's manifest and are not translated.
admin.plugins.title: Plugins
admin.plugins.rejectedWarning: {{count}} plugin(s) failed to load and are disabled — see the reason below.
admin.plugins.stopsAtRestart: Switched off: it no longer renders, serves data or runs tasks. Its backend stops at the next restart.
admin.plugins.storage.title: File storage
admin.plugins.storage.overridden: Set here. Clear to fall back to what the plugin asks for.
admin.plugins.storage.fromManifest: The plugin asks for {{quota}}. Saving a value here overrides that.
admin.plugins.storage.fromDefault: Using this site's default. Saving a value here overrides it.
admin.plugins.storage.hardCap: This server allows at most {{max}} per plugin.
admin.plugins.storage.belowUsage: Below what is already stored. Nothing is deleted, but no new uploads will succeed until files are removed.
admin.plugins.purgeConfirm: Delete all data stored by "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone. Its configuration and on/off state are kept.
admin.plugins.external.title: External services
admin.plugins.external.uses: Uses: {{kinds}}. Calls go through this site's provider, on this site's account.
admin.plugins.external.usedBy: Its interface can trigger a call for {{role}} and above.
admin.plugins.external.usedByAnyone: Its interface can trigger a call for anyone at all, signed in or not. On a provider you pay per call, that is an open spending endpoint.
consent.title: Before you carry on
consent.intro: This site stores what it needs to work: your session, your language, and this choice. Some content is loaded from other companies, which store things on your device too — that part is up to you.
consent.nothingOptional: Nothing on this site is loaded from another company, so there is nothing to allow or refuse.
consent.gpc: Your browser is asking sites not to share your data (Global Privacy Control), so nothing optional is loaded. You can still allow something here.
consent.categoryHint.necessary: Loaded whatever you choose, because the site cannot work without it.
consent.categoryHint.functional: Content embedded from other companies, such as players, maps or widgets.
consent.categoryHint.analytics: Counting visits so the people running this site can see what gets read.
consent.categoryHint.unreviewed: An add-on says the site needs this to work, and the people running the site have not confirmed that yet. Until they do, it is your choice.
consent.thirdCountry: Data may be transferred outside the EU/EEA
consent.storage.name: Name
consent.essential.title: Always active
consent.essential.intro: This is what the site itself stores. It is needed for the site to work, stays on your device or on our server, and is never used to profile you.
consent.essential.services: These services are part of how the site works, so there is nothing to switch off — but they store things too, and you should know what.
consent.purpose.csrf: Stops other sites from acting in your name
consent.purpose.site: Remembers the site's colours so the page does not flash white on load
consent.purpose.consent: Remembers the choice you make here
consent.purpose.consentCookie: Tells the server what you allowed, so it can block the rest
consent.purpose.progressPref: Remembers your choice about remembering the position
consent.purpose.rate: Remembers the playback speed you set
consent.progress.title: Remember where I stopped listening
consent.progress.hint: Only written once you press play, and only kept on this device. Switching it off deletes the positions already saved.
consent.progress.gpc: Off because your browser asked sites not to track you. Switching it on here overrides that for this site.
consent.receipt.title: Your choice
consent.receipt.decidedAt: You decided on {{date}}. We ask again after twelve months, or if the services on this site change.
consent.receipt.none: You have not made a choice yet.
admin.external.title: External services
admin.external.intro: Third-party services this instance may use. Nothing is selected by default — a service nobody configured makes no outbound call.
admin.external.noProviders: No provider is installed for this kind.
admin.external.noEncryptionKey: MOSAICAST_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set, so credentials entered here are stored in plain text and will appear in database backups. Prefer supplying them through the environment.
admin.external.loadFailed: Could not load the external services.
admin.seo.title: SEO & crawlers
admin.seo.intro: Search engines and AI crawlers read your site through robots.txt. Whether AI companies may use your episodes is your decision — Mosaicast ships the mechanism, not an opinion.
admin.seo.policy.allow.hint: say nothing about AI crawlers; they are treated like any other crawler
admin.seo.policy.block.hint: ask every AI crawler Mosaicast knows about not to crawl this site
admin.seo.policy.custom.hint: pick which crawlers to ask, one by one
admin.seo.catalogNote: This list is a starting point, not a limit — a crawler that appeared after this release can be blocked too, once support for naming it lands.
admin.seo.notEnforced: A robots.txt rule is a request, not a barrier. Well-behaved crawlers honour it; nothing here can stop one that ignores it.
admin.seo.loadFailed: Could not load the crawler settings.
admin.logs.title: Logs & health
admin.logs.last24h: {{errors}} errors, {{warnings}} warnings in the last 24 h
admin.users.title: Users
admin.users.confirmAdmin: Grant admin rights to {{name}}? Admins can manage everything, including other users.
admin.users.revertHelp: Puts this user back to the name they had before. You cannot choose the new name — it comes from their own history.
admin.users.confirmRevert: Revert {{name}} to their previous name? They will not be able to change it again for a while.
admin.users.selfLocked: You can't change your own role.
admin.site.name: Site name
error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: This page ran into an unexpected error. You can try again or go back to the home page.
admin.legal.title: Legal pages
admin.legal.draftWarning: This is an unsaved machine translation. Read it before saving — markdown links and formatting often come back damaged, and a legal page nobody has read is not safer for being automatic.
admin.legal.loadFailed: Could not load the legal pages.
admin.legal.deleteConfirm: Delete the page "{{slug}}" and all its translations? This cannot be undone.
notFound.title: Not found
admin.consent.title: Declared services
admin.consent.intro: Every third-party service an active plugin declares, and the plugin behind it. Visitors see the services and the companies; they never see plugin names. Switching a plugin off removes its services and narrows the policy below.
admin.consent.none: No active plugin declares a third-party service, so visitors are asked nothing.
admin.consent.cspIntro: The Content-Security-Policy is widened by exactly these. An origin that is not declared stays blocked even after a visitor consents.
admin.consent.failed: Could not load the consent audit.
admin.consent.necessaryPending: This add-on says visitors need not be asked about this service. Not yet confirmed by you, so visitors are still asked.
admin.consent.necessaryApproved: You confirmed that visitors need not be asked about this service, so it loads for everyone.
admin.consent.approveNecessary: Confirm as needed to run the site
search.title: Search
search.label: Search this site
search.hint: Type something to search episodes and everything the installed plugins know about.
search.failed: The search could not be run. Please try again.
search.timedOut: This section did not answer in time.
account.deleteBody: This removes your login, your access tokens and your listening progress, and asks every installed plugin to erase or anonymise what it holds about you. It cannot be undone.
account.deleteDone: Your account is gone, and every plugin finished its part.
account.deletePartial: Your account is gone. These plugins have not finished erasing their data yet and will be asked again: {{plugins}}.
account.deleteFailed: The account could not be deleted. Please try again.
admin.erasures.title: Unfinished account erasures
admin.erasures.help: These plugins have not yet erased the data of a deleted account. The host retries them hourly, and re-enabling a switched-off plugin settles its own.
admin.erasures.retryFailed: The retry could not be run.
